# T1.6′ (ADR 0309's per-tier gate: byte-identical goldens plus a crate-local
# fixture per behaviour change). The `Query` `method_not_found` message is
# generated from `QUERY_METHODS` (bynk-check/src/checker/kernels.rs), not
# hand-listed — `joinOn`/`groupBy` (ADR 0116/0120) once fell behind a
# hand-listed copy of this string undetected. The needle below is the whole
# message, so a dropped or reordered entry fails this line — the harness
# matches it as a substring of `category message`, so a pure append to the
# registry (a new entry with nothing removed or reordered) would not.
bynk.types.method_not_found the built-in `Query[Int]` type has no method `definitelyNotAMethod` — the kernel is `map`, `filter`, `flatMap`, `sortBy`, `sortByDescending`, `take`, `skip`, `distinct`, `distinctBy`, `joinOn`, `leftJoin`, `join`, `groupBy`, `collect`, `first`, `firstOrElse`, `count`, `fold`, `any`, `all`, `sum`, `min`, `max`, `average`, `forEach`, `parTraverse`, `traverseAll`, `parTraverseAll`, `traverseTry`, `parTraverseTry`
